name: Analyze Basic Content Info
description: Provides a plugin for analyzing basic content data like word count.
project_description: Analyze Basic Content Info is a submodule of Analyze that ships a single Analyze plugin, ContentInfo (id "content_info"), which reports fundamental statistics about a content entity: a rough word count and an image count. It renders the entity in its default view mode, strips tags, and counts words and occurrences, showing the result as a two-column summary table on the entity's Analyze tab. It has no full report, no configuration and no permissions of its own — it depends on the parent Analyze module for its tab, routing and access control.
